How Far is Windsor, Colorado from Denver, Colorado?

Planning a trip from Denver to Windsor, Colorado? Whether you're commuting, exploring new dining spots, or hitting the slopes at Hoe Down Hill, knowing the distance between these two locations is essential. Located approximately 60 miles north of Denver, Windsor is easily accessible via a scenic drive that takes about an hour, making it an ideal destination for a day trip or a relaxing weekend getaway.

Attractions in Windsor, Colorado

Hoe Down Hill: A Winter Wonderland

Hoe Down Hill offers a variety of winter activities, making it a standout attraction in Windsor. It features the longest tubing hill in North America and provides options for both novice and experienced skiers and snowboarders. With family-friendly slopes and more challenging runs, Hoe Down Hill caters to all ages and skill levels, ensuring a day full of excitement and fun​ (hoedownhill)​​(5280)​.

Dining Options in Windsor

Windsor Mill Tavern

Sitting in the historic Windsor Mill, Windsor Mill Tavern delights its guests with an array of craft cocktails and a menu full of enticing appetizers and entrees. This spot combines rich history with modern culinary delights, offering a warm atmosphere for a relaxing meal​ (windsormilltavern)​​ (Windsor Chamber of Commerce - CO)​.

Cacciatore at Heller's Kitchen

For those craving Italian, Cacciatore at Heller's Kitchen presents a charming setting to enjoy authentic Italian dishes. Located in the same Windsor Mill, it emphasizes fresh, local ingredients, bringing traditional Italian flavors to the forefront of its menu​ (windsormilltavern)​.

The drive from Denver to Windsor not only offers beautiful landscapes but also a variety of activities and dining experiences. Whether you're looking for adventure at Hoe Down Hill or a culinary journey at Windsor Mill, Windsor has something to offer for every visitor. This small town, just an hour's drive from Denver, provides a perfect escape with its blend of outdoor fun and gastronomic delights.
